intro.title: Forms & Validation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a user registration form that collects a name and email address. You'll learn how to create and manage form inputs using Vue's v-model directive for two-way data binding. The core concept is form validation, where you'll implement real-time feedback to check if the email is valid and if required fields are filled. You'll use Vue's reactive state and computed properties to handle validation logic and display error messages, giving you hands-on experience with form handling in Vue applications.
intro.usecase: Forms with validation are essential in nearly every interactive web application. You'll implement this pattern when building user registration forms, checkout processes in e-commerce sites, or data entry interfaces in admin dashboards. For example, when users sign up for a service, you need to validate email formats, password strength, and required fields before submission. In Vue, you'll create reactive form components that provide immediate feedback when users enter invalid data, preventing errors and improving user experience.
